description: Source code for the ReturnStatus controller in the Opencart admin module, handling CRUD operations and display logic for return statuses.

classes.name: ReturnStatus
classes.description: Controller class managing return status entities within the OpenCart admin interface, including listing, form handling, saving, and deleting return statuses.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial method to load the main return status page, setting up breadcrumbs, page title, and including header, column, and footer templates.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX or direct requests to fetch and display the list of return statuses.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates the HTML view for the return statuses list, including pagination and action links.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a return status, including loading language data and existing descriptions.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles form submissions to create or update a return status, including permission checks and validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected return statuses, with checks for default or in-use statuses.
